channel.title: The Line Of Best Fit - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Line Of Best Fit (thelineofbestfit.com)

item.title: By Storm - fka Injury Reserve – have a new album coming this month
item.description: Phoenix experimental hip-hop duo By Storm – rapper RiTchie and producer Parker Corey, previously of Injury Reserve, have detailed a debut album, My Ghosts Go Ghost to release this month.

item.title: Charli xcx releases new Wuthering Heights song "Wall Of Sound"
item.description: Charli xcx has revealed "Wall Of Sound", the third song from her upcoming Wuthering Heights soundtrack.

item.title: Rain Dogs, Robber Robber, ladylike and cootie catcher lead this week's New Music Discovery playlist
item.description: Our weekly playlist of brand new music from the last seven days by under-the radar artists hand-picked by our editors, staff and writers.

item.title: "Every song is ripped straight from my journal": LØLØ details diaristic new album god forbid a girl spits out her feelings
item.description: Toronto-based pop-rock artist LØLØ has announced her second studio album god forbid a girl spits out her feelings, inspired by "owning my sensitivity and emotion" and set for release this April

item.title: Pigeon announce debut album, OUTTANATIONAL
item.description: Margate psychedelic five-piece Pigeon have revealed the details of their upcoming debut album, OUTTANATIONAL, and shared lead single “Miami”.

item.title: Hayley Williams covers her grandfather’s song, “Friends or Lovers”
item.description: Rusty Williams has released a deluxe edition of his debut album, Grand Man, which features a cover of his song “Friends or Lovers” performed by Hayley Williams.

item.title: Call me Searows
item.description: Searows shares how the eerie maritime aesthetic of his new album connects to his intricate inside world.

item.title: Charlie Le Mindu's musical project MUCHAS PROBLEMAS demands entry with club-ready “Take Me In”
item.description: With the release of “Take Me In”, an intimate invitation to be disobedient, French multidisciplinary artist Charlie Le Mindu marks the inception of a musical project that feels dangerous, precarious.

item.title: Lucinda Williams rallies on World’s Gone Wrong
item.description: World’s Gone Wrong turns Lucinda Williams' urgent dismay and anger at the socio-political chaos that is tearing America apart into genuinely impactful and affecting art.

item.title: Bleech 9:3 sharpen their alt-grunge sensibilities with fervent new single “Cannonball”
item.description: Pulsing with emotion and visceral tension, the latest offering from Irish four-piece Bleech 9:3 retains a heartfelt vulnerability, capturing “the echoes of hell that are happening in there.”
